instances.input:
Now I understand the requirements better. Based on my analysis, I need to create a DSL code for a highway curve scenario with specific requirements. Let me create the CDA_001.osc file according to the specifications.

Looking at the examples, I'll create a highway bend scenario that tests vehicle stability on curves. I'll use the structure from the existing OSC files but adapt it to the specific requirements.
instances.output:
{"name": "create_file", "arguments": {"file_path": "CDA_001.osc", "content": "import "$PROJECT_DIR/projectLibs/project_scenario_base/project_base_scenario_model_ssp.osc"
import "$OSC2LIB/scenarios/free_drive/curved_road/ego_free_drive_on_curved_road.osc"
import "$OSC2LIB/scenarios/free_drive/npc_driving/npc_free_driving_top.osc"

extend test_config:
    set map = "$OSC2LIB/maps/M499_FTX_suburban.xodr"

scenario sut.highway_bend_test_run inherits project_base_scenario:
    keep(default scenario_str_generic == "highway_bend_test_run")
    
    in_road: one_way_road

    # Vehicle speed
    ego_speed: speed with:
        keep(default it == 60kph)
    
    # NPC distance in curve
    npc_distance_in_curve: length with:
        keep(default it == 30m)
        
    # Test duration
    duration_time: time with:
        keep(default it == 15s)
        
    # NPC vehicle type
    npc_vehicle_type: vehicle_category with:
        keep(default it == sedan)
    
    do parallel():
        set_up: serial():
            sut.car.drive() with:
                along(in_road)
                
        parallel():
            # Ego vehicle driving on curve
            ego_phase: sut.ego_free_drive_on_curved_road() with:
                keep(it.gen_curve_direction == right_curve)
                keep(it.gen_max_radius <= 150m)
                keep(it.gen_min_length >= 120m)
                keep(it.gen_start_offset == 0m)
                
            # NPC vehicle in curve
            npc_phase: sut.npc_free_driving() with:
                keep(it.npc_vehicle_type == self.npc_vehicle_type)
                keep(it.npc_relative_position == npc_distance_in_curve)
                keep(it.npc_initial_speed == 0kph)
                keep(it.npc_target_speed == 0kph)
                keep(it.npc_duration == duration_time)
                keep(it.ref_car == sut.car)

extend top.main:
    do sut.highway_bend_test_run()

extend test_additional_parameters:
    const test_index: string

extend test_config:
    set test_name = "highway_bend_test_run"
    set additional_parameters.test_index = "auto_20251126_000000""}

instruction: create a new OSC (OpenScenario) DSL file CDA_002.osc for a highway curve with lane change test scenario, output the corresponding structured function call with the correct file_path and content arguments.

instances.input: Now I understand the structure. Based on the requirements and examples, I'll create a DSL code file for the specified test scenario. Let me create the CDA_002.osc file with the proper structure:
instances.output:
{"name": "create_file", "arguments": {"file_path": "CDA_002.osc", "content": "# Test scenario: Highway curve with lane change
# Description: Test vehicle stability on curves and lane changing before curve entry
# Scenario: Highway curve with vehicle changing lanes before entering curve

import "$PROJECT_DIR/projectLibs/project_scenario_base/project_base_scenario_model_ssp.osc"
import "$OSC2LIB/scenarios/free_drive/curved_road/ego_free_drive_on_curved_road.osc"
import "$OSC2LIB/scenarios/free_drive/highway/ego_free_drive_on_highway.osc"
import "$OSC2LIB/scenarios/free_drive/npc_driving/npc_free_driving_top.osc"

extend test_config:
    set map = "$OSC2LIB/maps/M499_FTX_suburban.xodr"

scenario sut.highway_curve_lane_change_test inherits project_base_scenario:
    keep(default scenario_str_generic == "highway_curve_lane_change_test")
    
    in_road: highway
    
    # Ego vehicle speed
    ego_speed: speed with:
        keep(default it == 60kph)
    
    # Curve parameters
    curve_direction: string
    keep(default curve_direction == "right_curve")
    
    curve_radius: length with:
        keep(default it == 100m)
        
    curve_length: length with:
        keep(default it == 150m)
    
    # Lane change parameters
    initial_lane: int with:
        keep(default it == -2)  # Leftmost lane (outside lane)
        
    target_lane: int with:
        keep(default it == -1)  # Next lane inside
        
    # Trigger condition
    trigger_distance: length with:
        keep(default it == 80.0m)
    
    # Test duration
    duration_time: time with:
        keep(default it == 20s)
        
    # NPC vehicle type
    npc_vehicle_type: vehicle_category with:
        keep(default it == sedan)
    
    do parallel():
        set_up: serial():
            sut.car.drive() with:
                along(in_road)
                
        parallel():
            # Ego vehicle driving on highway before curve
            ego_phase: sut.ego_free_drive_on_highway() with:
                keep(it.gen_ego_lane_at_start == initial_lane)
                keep(it.gen_ego_lane_at_end == target_lane)
                keep(it.gen_ego_speed_at_start == ego_speed)
                keep(it.gen_ego_speed_at_end == ego_speed)
                keep(it.ego_driving_duration == duration_time)
                keep(it.ego_time_gap_to_start_of_road_element == 0.5s)
                
            # Curve section
            curve_phase: sut.ego_free_drive_on_curved_road() with:
                keep(it.gen_curve_direction == curve_direction)
                keep(it.gen_max_radius == curve_radius)
                keep(it.gen_min_length == curve_length)
                keep(it.gen_start_offset == trigger_distance)
                
            # NPC vehicle in curve
            npc_phase: sut.npc_free_driving() with:
                keep(it.npc_vehicle_type == self.npc_vehicle_type)
                keep(it.npc_relative_position == 30m)
                keep(it.npc_initial_speed == 0kph)
                keep(it.npc_target_speed == 0kph)
                keep(it.npc_duration == duration_time)
                keep(it.ref_car == sut.car)

extend top.main:
    do sut.highway_curve_lane_change_test()

extend test_additional_parameters:
    const test_index: string

extend test_config:
    set test_name = "highway_curve_lane_change_test"
    set additional_parameters.test_index = "auto_20251126_000000""}
